title: Simple Factory
description: Simple Factory for LLD interviews: one creation function from a type key, the registry-map variant that keeps Open/Closed, why it is not GoF, with Java, Python and C++ code.

hero.html:
Level 2 - Beginner20 min

Simple Factory

Put the "which concrete class do I build?" decision in one place, so the rest of your code asks for a product by name and only ever sees the interface. Then learn the registry-map version that keeps the factory closed to edits.

Seen in rounds at Amazon Razorpay - usually inside a parking lot, payment or notification problem, not as a standalone question.
